Case study · in production

A WhatsApp assistant that answers like a senior engineer.

For Partner Corporation SRL — a Romanian maker of cash registers and fiscal printers — we built a WhatsApp assistant grounded in the technical manuals of the Partner 200, 300 and 600 equipment. Field technicians get instant answers, with the source cited.

Sector

Channel

RAG · n8n · vector search
What it looks like

The question comes from the field. The answer comes from the manual.

The technician writes in WhatsApp, the way they would ask a colleague. The assistant searches the company's technical document collection, answers only from what it finds there, and says which manual and which section it read.

Partner Assistant · WhatsApp
The problem

The answer existed. It was just on page 84.

Before

  • Dozens of manuals, integration guides and internal procedures, as PDFs spread across several computers.
  • A technician on site, with an error on the screen, would phone a senior colleague — who was usually at a client too.
  • The same five questions, asked each time by someone else, got slightly different answers each time.

Now

  • Every document is indexed in one place and stays the company's property.
  • The technician asks in WhatsApp and gets the steps, with the manual and section cited, within seconds.
  • If the answer is not in the documents, the assistant says so — it does not invent a procedure.
How it works

RAG: the model reads before it answers.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation. The language model does not answer from its general memory, but from the document fragments it is handed for each question. That is why it can cite the source — and why it does not make things up.

Indexing

Manuals, guides and procedures are split into fragments, each tagged with the document title and the section it came from. The fragments become vectors in a semantic search database.

Retrieval

The WhatsApp question enters through an n8n workflow, is turned into the same kind of vector and compared against every fragment. The closest ones — usually three to five — are selected.

Grounded answer

The model receives the question and only those fragments, with the instruction to answer exclusively from them. The answer, with the document and section cited, goes back to WhatsApp.

Updates

A new manual or a revised procedure is added to the collection and available immediately. Nothing is retrained — one document is re-indexed.

The seniors' knowledge, available to every technician.

For technicians

One place to ask, open at any hour, that answers in the manual's own language and shows where it read from. Anyone who doubts an answer can open the cited section and check.

For the company

Knowledge that lived in a few people's heads now lives in the company's documents — and stays there when people leave. A new technician is useful from the first week.

For the data

The documents remain the company's, in its own database. Nothing is used to train any model.

Same mechanism, another collection

WhatsApp was their choice. It can be the chat on your website.

The assistant knows nothing about fiscal printers — it knows how to read a document collection. The same build answers from contracts, internal procedures, product catalogues or HR policies, and can be embedded directly in a website, an internal app or a messaging channel.
